Hashmap of old->new nodes; second pass wires random.

For copy random list hashmap I will allocate new nodes then assign next/random via the map.

```python
def copy_random(head):
    if not head: return None
    m = {}
    cur = head
    while cur:
        m[cur] = Node(cur.val)
        cur = cur.next
    cur = head
    while cur:
        m[cur].next = m.get(cur.next)
        m[cur].random = m.get(cur.random)
        cur = cur.next
    return m[head]
```
